title: Reshape the four role profiles to fit the AC3 ceilings, never revise the targets (DEC-194 follow-up to LCLI-682)
description:
Follow-up to LCLI-682, filed under DEC-194 (opum-ai/opum-doc#1007), which chose A for #577: the measuring feature lands, and the profiles are brought within the AC3 ceilings separately. Ordinary under DEC-182. opum-doc's ruling, verbatim:

"The follow-up's HOW is decided: reshape the profiles, never revise the targets. This is the first evidence that the packs are wrong, not the targets.
(1) Profiles pin only the cli-contract sections their role needs, by anchor (MDL-8). The rest is reachable by exact-section expansion. Policy and role at or under 3k; authored bootstrap at or under 8k.
(2) Evidence selection is capped at the spec's 6k default maximum, highest-scoring first. Required content still over budget fails the compile (CONTEXT_REQUIRED_CONTENT_OVER_BUDGET, MDL-9) and is never dropped.
(3) Prove it on all four real profiles with the same command class, each under its AC3 ceilings. Any residual comes back to me with numbers and the content behind them.
ODOC-437 AC3 stays unchecked until (3) holds; the overrun is noted there."

MEASURED EVIDENCE AT FILING. `lore agent context review --task "review the context budget change to the role profiles" --json`, on the LCLI-682 report: policyAndRole target 3000 measured 10712 OVER; taskEvidence target 6000 measured 48180 OVER; loreSubtotal target 11000 measured 59926 OVER; AC3 authoredBootstrapCeiling 8000 measured 10712 OVER; AC3 taskEvidenceCeiling 16000 measured 48180 OVER. The pinned `reference/cli-contract` ALONE is ~10712 estimated tokens, so one whole-document pin exceeds both the policy-and-role target and the authored-bootstrap ceiling before any task evidence is selected. That is the "packs are wrong, not the targets" evidence.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the four real role profiles pins only the cli-contract sections its role needs, by anchor, so the compiled pack's policy-and-role is at or under 3k and its AC3 authored bootstrap at or under 8k.
Evidence selection is capped at the spec's 6k default maximum, highest-scoring first, and required content still over budget fails the compile rather than being dropped.
All four real profiles are measured with the same command class and each reports under its AC3 ceilings; any residual is reported to opum-doc with the numbers and the content behind them.
